6.39 rsInvalidEmbeddedImageNameNotCLSCompliant
rsInvalidEmbeddedImageNameNotCLSCompliant is a critical error that will occur whenever the value
of the Name attribute of an EmbeddedImage element is not CLS-compliant [UTR15].
